title.narrative: Programa de Reforma del Sector Pblico
Public Sector Reform Program

description.narrative: This program aims at supporting the Government of Trinidad and Tobago in the initial stage of its longer-term strategy to reach developed country status. In particular, this operation aims at laying down the basis to assist the Government in improving the composition of public expenditure and the efficiency and effectiveness of the public sector, freeing resources to be used in productive investment (physical and human) and improving service delivery.
